core_problem_solved: To provide an XSLT processor for Java, allowing developers to transform XML documents into other formats (like HTML, text, or another XML structure) using XSLT 1.0 stylesheets and XPath 1.0 expressions.
key_features: An implementation of the XSLT 1.0 and XPath 1.0 W3C recommendations
Integration with the Java API for XML Processing (JAXP) as a transformation engine
Support for extension functions written in Java
era_and_niche: A foundational library in the Java XML ecosystem, serving as the default XSLT processor in many JDK versions and application servers throughout the 2000s.
reason_for_obsolescence: This library is a **legacy library**. It only supports the outdated XSLT 1.0 and XPath 1.0 standards, which lack many features required for complex transformations. The modern, state-of-the-art functional replacement for Xalan is the **Saxon** processor (`net.sf.saxon:saxon-he`), which implements the vastly more powerful XSLT 3.0 standard.
